name: FY2026 Form 1120 year-end records.eml
subject: HANGS Construction Services 2025 Form 1120 (FY2026) year-end records
body:
Hi,

Attached are the audited trial balance at June 30, 2026, the ledger detail you asked for and the equipment register with book and tax depreciation. Last year's return summary, the questionnaire, the tax payment log and the board resolution are in the shared folder. Please prepare the 2025 Form 1120 for our fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 for us to review. We filed Form 7004 on September 15 with a $15,000.00 payment.

A few things you will want to look at:

- We made no estimated payments during FY2026; the board expected last year's loss to cover the year.
- The depreciation software took 100% bonus on every FY2026 addition.
- The board resolution for officer pay still has to be signed.
- The crane we sold in March went through accumulated depreciation, not a gain account.
- Juniper Ridge paid pay application 1 on July 20.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC
